title: SAR ADC
text: N-bit successive approximation register (SAR) based ADC, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Output polarity} sets Defines ADC output polarity; {Number of bits} sets the number of physical output bits, {Input range (V)} sets the aDC dynamic range, {Use external start clock} sets the connect to external start conversion clock, {Conversion start frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency of internal start conversion clock, {RMS aperture jitter (s)} sets the rMS aperture jitter added to the start conversion, {SAR Frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency of SAR, {Match input scale} sets the inherit output polarity and data type, {Output data type} Defines ADC output data type fixdt, {Enable Linearity Impairments} enables linearity impairments in ADC, {Offset error} sets the shifts quantization steps by specific value and {Gain error} sets the error on slope of ADC transfer curve. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: start
ports.summary: External clock to start conversion scalar

ports.name: ready
ports.summary: Determines whether analog to digital conversion is complete scalar

params.name: Number of bits
params.values: Number of physical output bits 8 (default) | positive real integer in the range [1, 26]

params.name: Use external start clock
params.values: Connect to external start conversion clock on (default) | off

params.name: Conversion start frequency (Hz)
params.values: Frequency of internal start conversion clock 10e3 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: RMS aperture jitter (s)
params.values: RMS aperture jitter added to the start conversion clock 0 (default) | real nonnegative scalar

params.name: SAR Frequency (Hz)
params.values: Frequency of SAR clock 2e7 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Match input scale
params.values: Inherit output polarity and data type from input off (default) | on

params.name: Output polarity
params.values: Defines ADC output polarity Auto (default) | Bipolar | Unipolar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Defines ADC output data type fixdt(1,Nbits) (default) | fixdt(0,Nbits) | double | single | int8 | int16 | int32 | uint8 | uint16 | uint32 | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation

params.name: Enable Linearity Impairments
params.values: Enable linearity impairments in ADC simulation off (default) | on

params.name: Offset error
params.values: Shifts quantization steps by specific value 1 LSB (default) | real scalar

params.name: Gain error
params.values: Error on slope of ADC transfer curve 2 LSB (default) | real scalar
